purpose: Integrity and reproducible arithmetic of the current evaluation of all 94 independently scoped software IP assets. Project websites are digital displays only.

verification.browserIntegrity: The public renderer fetches the valuation register and methodology as raw text, recomputes SHA-256 in the browser and compares the result with this attestation.
verification.valuationReconciliation: The public renderer assembles the current asset register, applies published overrides, recalculates asset-level analytical economics and compares aggregate values with the published portfolio totals.
verification.publicSiteDirectory: The public project-site enhancer recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the site directory before presenting its integrity state.
verification.existenceBoundary: The timestamped public publication and matching digests demonstrate existence and integrity of the public commercial record as published. They do not independently prove authorship, legal title, patent priority, source-code identity, scientific validity, security assurance, certified valuation or commercial outcome.
verification.futureEconomicReferences: The renderer verifies and recalculates the current 94-asset maturity-sensitivity register; numeric entries change maturity only and are not forecasts or prices.
verification.sellerReadiness: The public renderer verifies the SHA-256 digests of the seller-readiness, ownership, supply-chain and audit-certificate records before presenting acquisition-readiness status.
verification.rightsTransfer: The public renderer verifies the seller-readiness, IP-ownership, software supply-chain, portfolio audit and rights-transfer records. The public transaction layer focuses on the offered rights, third-party obligations and transfer perimeter rather than internal development methods.
verification.projectEvaluations: All 94 software-asset reassessments share the current evaluation timestamp, record the prior basis and distinguish updated, newly evaluated and reconfirmed results without disclosing implementation detail.

privacyBoundary: Public records expose seller-side commercial, rights, transfer, evidence and non-sensitive supply-chain metadata only. Internal development methods, proprietary know-how, credentials, customer data, sensitive implementation details and transaction-confidential material remain outside the public showroom.
